ROOT.proceduredef: CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.Reindeksacja @Wynikow int = 0 as begin declare @Tabela sysname, @ind int, @cnt int, @div int select @ind=1, @cnt=count(*), @div=count(*)/case when @wynikow>0 then @wynikow else 1 end+1 from sysobjects inner join sysusers on sysobjects.uid=sysusers.uid WHERE sysobjects.xtype='U' and sysusers.name='CDN' select @ind-1 as Ind, @cnt as cnt, '' as tabela DECLARE ListaTabel CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT sys.schemas.name+'.'+sysobjects.name FROM sysobjects JOIN sys.schemas ON sysobjects.uid=sys.schemas.schema_id WHERE sysobjects.xtype='U' and sys.schemas.name='CDN' ORDER BY sysobjects.name OPEN ListaTabel WHILE 1=1 BEGIN FETCH NEXT FROM ListaTabel INTO @Tabela IF @@FETCH_STATUS<>0 BREAK if @ind%@div=0 select @ind-1 as Ind, @cnt as cnt, @Tabela as Tabela exec sp_executesql N'DBCC DBREINDEX (@Tabela) WITH NO_INFOMSGS', N'@Tabela sysname', @Tabela set @ind = @ind+1 END CLOSE ListaTabel DEALLOCATE ListaTabel if @Wynikow>0 select @ind-1 as Ind, @cnt as cnt, 'KONIEC' as Tabela end
